description: Original polished HD-2D game pixel-art single isolated static sprite. Fixed camera looks down 35 degrees from above, orthographic-like three-quarter volume, not a flat side elevation. Neutral broad diffuse daytime material color for later real-time lighting: no night tint, no glow, no colored rim light, no directional cast shadow, no ground, no platform, no scenery, no text, no checkerboard. Entire subject visible with a few transparent margin pixels, transparent RGBA background. One mature WIND-SHEARED FIR TREE, about 7m tall. Dense layered needles form a beautiful irregular narrow conifer silhouette, upper leader bent slightly to the left by wind, asymmetrical staggered branch shelves. NOT a perfect geometric Christmas-tree triangle. Lower right limbs reach farther, upper left branches are weather-gnarled. Convincing dense blue-grey-green and deep muted olive needle tufts with rounded three-dimensional volumes, soft natural midtone highlights. Thick deeply grooved dark grey-brown trunk visible in lower quarter, stout branch junctions and spreading knuckled roots. Old damp mixed-forest fir, alive and substantial. Entire trunk and crown visible. No snow, no ornaments, no ground or surrounding grass.
